steps.summary: In Step 1, I tapped the calculator’s ‘清除’ control at the red-marked position on the far left of the function row. The selected tab was ‘计算’, beside ‘换算’ and ‘税贷’; the history area showed ‘125+75=200’, and the large current display showed ‘3’ with ‘= 3’ below. The keypad also showed %, ÷, ×, −, +, digits 0–9, a decimal point, and utility icons.

In Step 2, I tapped the red-marked “1” key on the calculator keypad. The selected tab was “计算,” beside “换算” and “税贷”; the main display read “0,” and faint prior history showed “125+75=200.” The keypad also showed “AC,” delete, “%,” division, digits 7–9, 4–6, 2–3, “0,” a decimal point, multiplication, subtraction, addition, and equals. No fresh calculation expression was visible on the display.

In Step 3, I tapped the '2' key marked in red on the system calculator's selected '计算' tab. The screen also showed the tabs '换算' and '税贷', a faint prior expression '125+75=200', and a large '1' with '= 1' beneath it. The keypad displayed 'C', a delete icon, '%', '÷', digits '7–9', '4–6', and '1–3', plus '0', a decimal point, arithmetic operators, and an orange equals button.

In Step 4, I tapped the red-marked “5” key on the system calculator screen. The “计算” tab was selected beside “换算” and “税贷”; a faint history line read “125+75=200,” while the current display showed “12” and “= 12.” The keypad showed C, backspace, %, ÷, digits 7–9, 4–6, 1–3, 0, decimal, ×, −, +, and the orange equals key.

In Step 1, I tapped the red-marked “清除” key at the far left of the calculator keypad’s top row; its symbol is mostly covered by the marker. The calculator screen showed “8+17” above the large result “25.” The keypad also displayed %, backspace, ÷, digits 7 through 9, 4 through 6, 1 through 3, 00, 0, a decimal point, ×, −, +, and an orange = key. The status bar showed 00:40, 5G, and 65% battery; no dialog was visible.

In Step 2, I tapped the first circular function key in the top row of the keypad, where the red marker covered a target-like icon; no text label was visible on that key. The screen showed the system calculator with a blank display area and no expression or result. The keypad also showed %, delete, and ÷ across its top row, followed by number keys, ×, −, +, a decimal point, 00, 0, and an orange = key. The status bar read 00:41 and showed 66% battery.

steps.summary: In Step 6, I tapped the red-marked faint history entry near the upper-right display, reading “125+75=200.” The calculator screen had “计算” selected, with “换算” and “税贷” beside it; the main display showed “125+” and “= 125.” Below were the clear, delete, percent, divide, digit, multiply, subtract, add, decimal, and equals controls. The red marker sits over the faint history expression; this frame provides no post-action screen evidence.

In Step 7, I tapped the “200” at the right end of the faint history entry “125+75=200,” where the red marker is positioned. The calculator has the “计算” tab selected, with “换算” and “税贷” beside it. Its large display reads “125+,” and the result line below reads “= 125”; the keypad shows C, delete, %, ÷, digits 7–9, 4–6, and 1–3, plus 0, a decimal point, and ×, −, and + controls. No “600” is visible.

In Step 8, I long-pressed at [880,193] on the blank white area below the '税贷' tab; no red marker is visible in this frame, and the gray history line reads '125+75=200'. The calculator screen has '计算' highlighted in orange beside '换算' and '税贷'. Its main display reads '125+' with '= 125' below. The keypad shows C, delete, %, ÷, digits 0–9, a decimal point, ×, −, +, and an orange '=' button.

In Step 9, I tapped the red-marked history expression “125+75=200” on the calculator’s “计算” page; the marker is over the expression near its “+” sign. The page also shows the tabs “换算” and “税贷,” while the main calculation area reads “125+” with “= 125” beneath it. The visible keypad includes C, delete, %, ÷, digits 0–9, a decimal point, ×, −, +, and =, and no dialog is visible.

In Step 11, I tapped the upper-left back control marked in red on the calculator page, whose centered title reads “计算器.” The screen shows “帮助反馈” with the “评分” row, then an “关于” section containing “检查更新” and “当前版本：11.0.1,” followed by “隐私政策”; chevrons appear beside those three rows. No live calculator display or “=” key is visible on this frame, so no current value appears here.

In Step 12, I tapped the bottom-left “1” key marked in red on the calculator screen. The orange “计算” tab is selected beside “换算” and “税贷”; the pale history line reads “125+75=200,” while the current expression reads “125+” and the large display shows “=125.” The keypad shows C, delete, %, ÷, digit rows 7–9, 4–6, and 1–3, with ×, −, and + at right, and 0, a decimal point, and an orange equals key along the bottom.

In Step 13, I tapped the orange plus key marked in red on the calculator screen. The selected tab was “计算,” beside “换算” and “税贷”; the display showed “1” and “= 1,” with history lines “125+75=200” and “125+=125.” The visible keypad included C, backspace, %, ÷, digits 7–9, 4–6, 1–3, ×, −, +, 0, a decimal point, and =, with a swap icon at lower left.

In Step 14, I tapped the red-marked “1” key in the calculator keypad. The “计算” tab was selected beside “换算” and “税贷”; the display showed “1+” and “= 1”, with history entries “125+75=200” and “125+=125”. The keypad showed C, delete, %, ÷, digits 7–9, 4–6, 1–3, 0, a decimal point, ×, −, +, and =. The status bar showed 1:15 and 100% battery, and no dialog was visible.
